pass_meta.pass: Location switching, via the picker in the profile menu

C45152.observed: Proved with a job seeded at each shop - S-17717 at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and S-17718 at Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Standing at Heavy Duty, search returns S-17717 and not S-17718. The shop was then changed from the profile menu, the way a person does it, to Staging Lethbridge - 4310 - no sign-out and no reload. Search then returns S-17718 and no longer returns S-17717. The two readings are a clean swap, so changing shop refreshes what search gives you.

C55684.observed: Same reading as the check above. After moving from Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 to Staging Lethbridge - 4310, the job belonging to the first shop, S-17717, is no longer returned by search, while the second shop's own job S-17718 is. The previous shop's work disappears as it should.
